description: Space Alpha builds Mispriced Winters: weather derivatives are often priced by averaging past winters, but winters keep getting warmer, so those prices overstate the cold. We use NASA POWER temperatures to find the warming trend, measure its cost in dollars and test it with a backtest. A working Python app is already built. We’re looking for Python/data skills, stats or quant finance, data viz, and pitch/demo design. Want to actively build? Send a join request.
